# Constructor ParameterId

#### ParameterId(ElementExId, string)

Initializes a new instance of the ParameterId structure.

##### Declaration

```
public ParameterId(ElementExId inElementId, string inName)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- |
